description: This file defines a custom gradient scaler class 'ShardedGradScaler' for distributed training in PyTorch, supporting mixed precision, CPU offloading, and synchronization across nodes. It extends the 'GradScaler' class and includes support for multiple devices and process groups.

classes.name: _GeneralMultiDeviceReplicator
classes.description: A class extending _MultiDeviceReplicator to support serving tensors to request devices, including support for 'cpu'.

classes.name: ShardedGradScaler
classes.description: A custom gradient scaler for distributed, sharded, and mixed precision training supporting multiple devices and process groups.

methods.name: _refresh_per_optimizer_state
methods.description: Initializes optimizer state with stage 'READY' and empty inf per device.

methods.name: _is_supported_device
methods.description: Checks if a tensor's device is supported (CUDA, XLA, CPU, HPU, MTIA, XPU, or private backend).

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Scales the input tensor(s) by the current scale factor, supporting tensors and iterables of tensors.

methods.name: _unscale_grads_
methods.description: Unscales gradients for an optimizer, checking for inf/nan values and preparing tensors for distributed synchronization.

methods.name: unscale_
methods.description: Performs unscale operation on optimizer gradients, including distributed synchronization of inf/nan detection.

methods.name: _amp_update_scale_cpu_
methods.description: Updates the scale factor on CPU based on detected inf/nan values.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the scale factor based on inf/nan detection, with options for manual setting.
